blockers:
1. Pin (repo-standards): `version: "0.6.13"` is a hardcoded constant in `packages/runtime/src/pi/provider.ts` (`PROVIDERS`). `scripts/dependency-pins.ts` and `update-dependencies.ts` have no pin kind for it, so `deps:update` and `deps:check` never see it.
   - The docs say the opposite. `docs/pi/README.md:19` and `docs/pi/installation.md:43-44` say every reused extension "is pinned and moves only through `mise run deps:update`". AGENTS.md says the same about dependencies.
   - Nothing states the gap as an accepted decision.
   - `piPackages` returns the bare name `pi-provider-kimi-code`, so the pin is never applied. `providerSource` has no caller outside its test, and the only test asserts the literal string.
   - Fix, one of: teach the updater this pin, or record the gap as a decision with a test and correct the "moves only through deps:update" wording. Either way, make the loader and `providerSource` agree.

notes (optional):
- `readiness.ts:83`: exit 1 is always "not logged in" and the `--json` status is not parsed. This matches the requirement ("exit 1 not_ready"), so it is optional.
- `catalog.ts` `parseModelCatalog`: hand-parsed with no Schema decode, so a trailing footer line becomes a fake entry. An empty catalog is reported as missing model ids even though credentials may be the cause. Readiness-before-catalog ordering is only a comment.
- `detailOf` (stdout first) and the catalog detail (stderr first) disagree, and the truncation is duplicated.
- `providerEnv`, `providerSource`, `validateModelCatalog` and `requireProviderReady` have no caller, yet the docs describe a launcher using them. Reword the docs as "provided for the launcher".
- The `/code-review` skill was the built-in; its six findings are covered above. I rejected none as false. I classed finding 1 as the blocker and the rest as optional.
